title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a solar irradiance of 1,361 W/m²
summary: The fact sheet lists the solar irradiance at Earth as 1,361 watts per square meter.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists solar irradiance as 1,361.0 watts per square meter. This is the number on that sheet. It is not a reconstruction of the planetary energy budget.
